positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed for the Fitness+ service on iOS, tvOS, and watchOS.
- Collaborated with cross-functional partners to deliver growth-related features in the service.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed for the Mint iOS app using Swift and Objective-C.
- Imagined and implemented a reactive persistence library built on top of SQLite that supports dynamic data structures unknown at compile-time.
- Presented to the Mint iOS engineering team on combining MVVM architecture with dependency injection to produce code that supports isolation testing via mocking.
- Implemented the Net Worth and Spending data visualizations at the top of the Mint overview as part of the product revamp.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams remotely via Slack and Zoom.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Developed Swift SDKs to centralize code shared among a family of client apps. 
• Implemented front-end features for a family of media streaming apps. 
• Communicated regularly with stakeholders in other locations via Slack and video calls.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed for the MyChart mobile app on both Android and iOS platforms.
• Completed a 6 month, full-stack project which re-engineered the MyChart Appointments module.
• Led the bug-fixing team of 3 developers and always achieved target quality levels.
• Owned the iOS release process for MyChart.
• Mentored a new-hire and an intern.
• Provided technical support for customer development teams using the MyChart library.
• Established the use of the MVVM design pattern to enhance testability in the MyChart mobile app.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an iOS mobile application in Objective-C using the Cocoa Touch class, object-oriented design, and the model-view-controller pattern. 
- Leveraged the mock-up design tool, Balsamiq, to create workflows
- Submitted mock-ups for design reviews 10 times to refine the user interface
- Presented my project to 150 Epic employees including the Chief Operating Officer

positions.title: Engineering Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Prepared an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to image an archaeological site in Peru
- Developed an Android mobile application that generates the optimal GPS waypoints for a UAV's flight
- Modified the UAV's open-source flight control app to generate waypoints

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Constructed and modified a 3D printer
- Wrote Java programs for generating G-code files for 3D printed structures
- Programmed a touchscreen in Arduino to control peristaltic pumps
- Wrote MATLAB programs for image processing
- Presented a poster to Vanderbilt engineering faculty during a summer research fair
- Collaborated with a team of 7 lab members

I researched generating artificial tissue scaffolds using a 3D printer. I assembled a 3D printer with heat extrusion capabilities, designed a pressure extrusion system, and modified the printer's open source firmware in Arduino to control the new pressure system. 

In addition, I programmed a touch screen in Arduino to control a peristaltic pump system.

company.name: Bellan Lab for Advanced Materials at Vanderbilt University

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Engineering with Engineering Management Minor
